items.why: Model Vault moved from per-instance Performance Tier plans to per-GPU hourly rates, with a promo column through Mar 2027.

record.short: Model Vault moves from per-instance plans at $3-$7/hr to per-GPU rates of $3.00-$12.50/hr on demand.
record.headline: Cohere replaced Model Vault’s per-instance Performance Tier plans with a per-GPU rate card running from L4 to GB200, with promo rates through Mar 2027.
record.who: Model Vault customers, who now pay by GPU type rather than by model-specific instance; whether existing commitments are grandfathered is not shown.
record.read: Cost now depends on which chip a workload runs on rather than on the model, so buyers have to size spend by GPU hours. The low promo rates look designed to ease the move, and they end in Mar 2027.
record.caveat: The previous Model Vault change on this page was tagged as part of an A/B test, so this restructure may also still move.
